EC1: - Any reported condition [OR] or behaviour deemed either to pose undue personal risk [OR] to the participant or introduce bias
EC2: - Any diagnosed metabolic disease (e.g. type 1 [OR] or type 2 diabetes)
EC3: - Any reported use of substances which may pose undue personal risk [OR] to the participants or introduce bias into the experiment (e.g. smoking/ [OR] substance abuse)
EC4: - Lifestyle [NOT] not conforming to standard sleep-wake cycle (e.g. shift worker)
EC5: - Any reported recent (<6 months) change in body mass (± 3%)
